observations.detail: Installed TEST-01 native Client opened Host revision 1, then only TEST-02 VentioHost service was stopped while VentioPostgres remained Running. TEST-01 native form saved name test01 offline conflict edit 20261122. Read-only installed SQLite copy showed extension.record.update command 0ad4bf52-b026-44dd-84d6-678344f2d51c PENDING, attempt 0, no receipt.

TEST-02 VentioHost was restarted; its installed native Client edited the same record to test02 online wins conflict 20261122 and invoked Sync pending. Authenticated Host records/query returned that exact name at revision 2, record count eight.
Before TEST-01 Sync pending, TEST-01 RDP disconnected and TCP 22 stopped responding during a reported power outage. No rejection or conflict receipt has been observed. Do not mark this phase PASS.

Pinned SSH identity VENTIO-TEST-01 and read-only installed SQLite showed the same pending command, attempt 0 after power restoration. Relaunched installed native Ventio Client, retained Host profile and ACTIVE_LOCAL package, invoked Sync pending. Installed SQLite command 0ad4bf52-b026-44dd-84d6-678344f2d51c became CONFLICT, attempt 1. Host receipt status CONFLICT, reasonCode REVISION_CONFLICT, currentRevision 2, retryable false, serverTimestamp 2026-11-22T06:50:54.034285Z. Native Synchronization UI showed Pending 0, Host confirmed 2, Conflicts 1 and the conflicting extension.record.update with one attempt and Host reason REVISION_CONFLICT.

Authenticated TEST-02 Host records/query returned eight records and the target record ee249212-9761-44c6-84a1-0f5242f73904 at revision 2 with name test02 online wins conflict 20261122. The rejected TEST-01 offline name did not overwrite authoritative Host data.
